summary: Atelier MVP fully tested. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests pass against the public preview URL (root, idempotent seed, clients list w/o _id, create+get client, NL parse via Claude Sonnet 4.5 returning IST +05:30 future design_call, event creation with mock meet_link + 3 reminders, events range, invoice item create/update/delete with persistence verification, share token + public HTML containing client name). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): Today screen renders heading + schedule-input + parse-button; parsing 'Schedule a design call for Anaïs at 6pm IST on coming Wednesday' produced a valid schedule-preview with a CONFIRM & SCHEDULE button. Calendar tab shows month label 'June 2026', 4 mode chips (Design Call, Measurement Call, Sending Pieces, Personal) and a full day grid; chips toggle and day cells select. Clients tab lists seeded + newly-created clients (TEST_UI_Client visible after fab-create-client → field-name → save-client flow). Client detail screen shows Measurements, Design Sheets (Upload PDF) and Invoice (Add item) sections. Mocked Resend + mock meet link behave as expected (HTTP 2xx, console log).

ui_bugs.issue: Confirm button testID is 'confirm-event' but spec referenced 'confirm-event-button'. Functionality works; naming mismatch only.
Chips testID is 'mode-toggle-${key}' but spec referenced 'mode-chip-*'. Functionally toggling works.
Day cells testID is 'day-${iso}' but spec referenced 'day-cell-*'. Tap-to-select works.

action_items: Optional: align testIDs with original spec for consistency (rename 'confirm-event' → 'confirm-event-button', 'mode-toggle-*' → 'mode-chip-*', 'day-*' → 'day-cell-*'). Functionality is correct; only naming differs.
Minor backend lint: two pytest tests have unused `return` values (warnings only, not failures).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses asyncio.run inside BackgroundTasks (_send_email_sync). This is fine while RESEND_API_KEY is empty (mocked path returns immediately), but if a real key is set later, asyncio.run in a sync task can be fragile when nested in async contexts — consider FastAPI native async background or anyio.from_thread.
PUBLIC_BASE_URL is read once at import; share URL relies on it being set correctly in .env (it is).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (functional); testID names diverge from spec on 3 elements

seed_data_creation: POST /api/_seed seeded the 3 demo clients (idempotent). Tests also created TEST_Pytest Client, TEST_Invoice Client and TEST_UI_Client which are left in DB (prefixed TEST_ for easy cleanup).
